title: Orchid Palais Wedding Cake
description: Six graduated ivory tiers frame two cascading trails of white orchids and roses. Fine vertical pleating alternates with smooth panels, while small pearl borders follow each tier. The design is intended as a tall focal point for a formal wedding reception.

title: Rose Cathedral Wedding Cake
description: Seven tiers of delicate ivory lacework are wrapped in a continuous spiral of blush garden roses and ivory peonies. The flowers become fuller towards the base, giving the tall silhouette a soft, romantic balance.

title: Jardin Imperial Wedding Cake
description: Eight graduated tiers combine raised botanical details with generous collars of ivory flowers. Roses, hydrangeas and jasmine form an asymmetric cascade, bringing a flowering garden to a grand reception table.

title: Magnolia Opera Wedding Cake
description: Nine tiers create a slender, architectural silhouette. Large ivory magnolias sweep across alternating smooth and filigree panels, with restrained champagne gold details and fine pearl borders. The open arrangement lets the shape of each flower stand out.

title: Fleur Sovereign Wedding Cake
description: Ten tiers of ornamental ivory scrollwork rise between abundant garlands of blush roses and peonies. Fine jasmine trails connect the floral collars into an elaborate, symmetrical centrepiece.

title: Grand Floral Palace Wedding Cake
description: A ten-tier central tower is accompanied by two five-tier cake towers on a shared floral base. Cascades of white orchids and blush roses link intricate ivory lacework into one monumental wedding installation. Venue access, structural support and assembly form part of the individual consultation.

title: Blush Garden Wedding Cake
description: Two ivory tiers carry a generous crown of blush and white roses, with a smaller floral arrangement at the base. Pearl borders define the soft silhouette.

title: Ivory Gilded Wedding Cake
description: Three ivory tiers are edged with irregular gold detailing and a restrained arrangement of white flowers. A floral crown and lower clusters balance the clean stacked silhouette.

title: Peony Ballet Wedding Cake
description: Four graduated tiers are wrapped in soft ivory draping. A generous diagonal trail of blush peonies and ivory garden roses runs from the floral crown to the base, with fine pearl accents between the folds.

title: Orchid Reverie Wedding Cake
description: Five tiers combine smooth ivory panels and delicate draping. A long cascade of white orchids traces one side of the cake, giving the tall silhouette a graceful asymmetry.

title: Rose Pavilion Wedding Cake
description: Five substantial tiers are separated by full collars of blush roses and ivory peonies. Alternating lattice and botanical relief panels create a richly detailed garden-inspired centrepiece.
